verdict.rationale: Zapier stores app connections centrally and reuses them (they are 'brought in automatically' to MCP). It also references 'managed connections', 'workspace controls' and 'permissions you control' at the org level, and teammates can get view or edit access to an MCP server on Team and Enterprise plans. However, no evidence shows sharing an individual connection with teammates or granting per-credential usage rights; the sharing control shown applies to MCP servers, not credentials. Missing for 10: documented sharing of individual app connections with team members, per-credential access controls (who can use which connection), detail on how 'managed connections' work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
